QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Gallero's Guide to Daily Commissions
QuestInfo.0: Gallero has something to say. Click on the light bulb at the left side of the screen.
QuestInfo.1: Now that the castle is open, you can get daily commissions from Gallero. You can do three commissions per day and Gallero can change the commissions if you give him some Mesos. Complete commissions to get Shadowdealer Coins, which can be used to purchase special items.
QuestInfo.2: Now that the castle is open, you can get daily commissions from Gallero. You can do three commissions per day and Gallero can change the commissions if you give him some Mesos. Complete commissions to get Shadowdealer Coins, which can be used to purchase special items.

0.0: Hey. Gallero here from the Shadowdealers. I heard a lot about you from Tonero! Congratulations on getting into the castle!

no.0: That's a shame. Give it some thought!

0.1: The Shadowdealers want to do more trading now that you've gotten into the castle! I speak of course of the daily commissions! Are you ready to hear about it?

yes.0: Come to me every day, and I'll have up to 3 daily commission quests for you. They're a great way to get Shadowdealer Coins.
yes.1: If you don't like the commissions I have, for a little fee I can set you up with a new one. You may end up repeating an old commission that way, though...
yes.2: So start doing commissions today and make a huge profit. Or not. I don't really care.
